accepted_initial_scope: Basic bounded finite current holds, with raw buffer-relative timestamps and explicitly unknown START/electrical aperture alignment wherever not established. Approximate 10 ms alignment is a desired target, not a demonstrated accuracy bound.
current_hardware: Last verified run2026110208 IDLE/OFF/0 A with one archived/matched proof reading retained and default-buffer extents preserved. No new hardware action/discard is authorized by this scope preference.
implementation_state: Simulator Flyer and guarded M4 finite current-hold acquisition exist; operational hardware backend/projection and explicit unknown-START contract support remain to be implemented/reviewed. Existing hard gate has not been silently removed.
next_bench_scope: Define pass/fail cases before energizing: normal finite acquisition and collection, missing START timeout, programmatic abort, and recovery plus retained-data integrity. Case count is a planning breakdown, not a guarantee of four executions or full hardware-gate acceptance. Coarse timing check should target requested ~10 ms tolerance; no separate aperture precision claim.
next_software_work: Coherently revise timing contracts/model to represent unknown actual START instead of relabelling first-reading zero as START. Preserve raw times and per-field unknown apertures.
Implement bounded finite-current-hold hardware backend using packaged runtime and single connection owner; no added arbitrary TSP or per-sample LAN control.
Validate real backend lifecycle/projection with meaningful transport tests before new bench acceptance.
stopping_decision: No more identical constant-resistor START/BUSY repeats proposed; fine per-field aperture calibration is outside initial usability scope.
user_reports_verbatim: Basic finite holds; timing explicitly uncalibrated
a rough time calibration will probably do, on the order of 10 ms is fine.
